entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4690"/><div sID="gen6812" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4690"/>5. Rather, "a torch" (lamp) is an object of contempt in the thoughts of him who rests securely (is at ease), though it was prepared for the falterings of the feet [Umbreit] (<reference osisRef="Prov.25.19">Pr 25:19</reference>). "Thoughts" and "feet" are in contrast; also rests "securely," and "falterings." The wanderer, arrived at his night-quarters, contemptuously throws aside the torch which had guided his uncertain steps through the darkness. As the torch is to the wanderer, so Job to his friends. Once they gladly used his aid in their need; now they in prosperity mock him in his need. <div eID="gen6812" type="x-p"/>

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4692"/><div sID="gen6815" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4692"/>7-8. Beasts, birds, fishes, and plants, reasons Job, teach that the violent live the most securely (<reference osisRef="Job.12.6">Job 12:6</reference>). The vulture lives more securely than the dove, the lion than the ox, the shark than the dolphin, the rose than the thorn which tears it. <div eID="gen6815" type="x-p"/>

entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv4698"/><div sID="gen6821" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv4698"/>13. In contrast to, "with the ancient is wisdom" (<reference osisRef="Job.12.12">Job 12:12</reference>), Job quotes a saying of the ancients which suits his argument, "with Him (God) is (the true) wisdom" (<reference osisRef="Prov.8.14">Pr 8:14</reference>); and by that "wisdom and strength" "He breaketh down," &c., as an absolute Sovereign, not allowing man to penetrate His mysteries; man's part is to bow to His unchangeable decrees (<reference osisRef="Job.1.21">Job 1:21</reference>). The Mohammedan saying is, "if God will, and how God will." <div eID="gen6821" type="x-p"/>
